messages:
acme-support (Acme Customer): Hi, we noticed that the 'Viewer' role in our org shows empty analytics for the last 90d in the Console. Admins still see data. Started ~Aug 10 after retention policy update. org_id: org_78321. Screenshot: https://acme.screens/12345

alex (Support): thanks — can you confirm whether this is for all dashboards or just Usage / API metrics? any filters applied?

acme-support (Acme Customer): Just the reports under Analytics > Usage and Team activity. No extra filters. When I switch to Admin role everything populates. Viewer role shows rows but numbers are zeros.

alex (Support): got it. can you run this quick api call and paste the response?
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/org_78321/analytics?range=90d&role=viewer"
```

acme-support (Acme Customer): response attached — large JSON but relevant part is aggregation == 0 for all metrics.

alex (Support): thx. tagging SRE /eng on this. @devon can you take a look? i suspect retention scoping but want to confirm.

devon (SRE): on it. quick question: did the customer flip the retention_lock flag in the tenant settings yesterday? we pushed a change that enforces retention_lock_days for linked orgs last night.

acme-support (Acme Customer): yes, we enabled 'retention lock' to 60 days as requested by compliance.

devon (SRE): hm. reproducing locally with a test org + retention_lock=60. initial triage: query that computes role-scoped aggregates joins events -> role_membership table and applies TTL filter. looks like when retention_lock is present, the TTL check uses org_ttl instead of role_ttl_scope, causing role-scoped hits to be excluded. i can trigger the same zeroed metrics for viewer role in staging.

alex (Support): ok that's actionable. can you paste the failing query snippet?

devon (SRE): snippet below:
```sql
SELECT r.role, COUNT(e.*) as events
FROM events e
JOIN role_membership r ON r.user_id = e.user_id AND r.org_id = e.org_id
WHERE e.timestamp >= now() - interval '90 days'
  AND e.ttl >= now() -- (wrong column used: org_ttl instead of role_ttl)
GROUP BY r.role;
```

devon (SRE): the bug was introduced in the retention refactor — we moved TTL evaluation into a shared predicate but didn't thread the role scope through. so role-based TTLs get compared against org-level retention and records get filtered out.

jordan (PM): severity? customer impact?

devon (SRE): high for any customer using retention_lock + role-restricted views. Admins (full-scope) see data. Viewers get zeroes. Repro steps: 1) enable retention_lock on tenant 2) create a user with Viewer role, generate events older than role_ttl but within org_ttl 3) query Console -> viewer metrics -> returns zeros.

alex (Support): assigned ENG-5187, escalating to eng-runtime. @jordan can you include this in the next deploy cut? customer is blocked for audit reporting.

jordan (PM): yes adding ENG-5187 to hotfix queue. ETA for patch?

devon (SRE): i have a narrow patch that fixes the predicate to use COALESCE(role_ttl, org_ttl) when evaluating per-user joins. i'll push to staging for verification.

acme-support (Acme Customer): any temporary workaround we can use? we need reports for auditors tomorrow.

alex (Support): two options: 1) add the users to a role with relaxed scope temporarily (not ideal) 2) disable retention_lock until patch deploy (may conflict with compliance). which is less risky?

acme-support (Acme Customer): compliance won't allow disabling retention_lock. can we do the role change for just the audit accounts?

devon (SRE): yes, we can add an audit-specific role with broader scope for the next 48hrs. i'll coordinate with you.

alex (Support): I'll open a short-lived role and grant to audit users. acme-support, please DM names/emails.

acme-support (Acme Customer): sending list now. thanks.

devon (SRE): pushed patch to staging: 84a3f2c. Running integration tests for metrics pipeline. if green i'll request hotfix rollout.

ingest-bot: [ingest] job metrics-agg-staging succeeded in 12m 3s (run id: r-20284)

devon (SRE): tests green. requesting approval for hotfix deploy to prod 02:00 UTC.

jordan (PM): approved. scheduling ENG-5187 for 02:00 UTC hotfix window. noticifying oncall.

alex (Support): noted. acme-support — once patch is live we'll re-run your report and confirm numbers. i'll keep you updated. :thumbsup:

acme-support (Acme Customer): great, appreciate the quick response. will wait for confirmation.

alex (Support): post-deploy checklist: 1) re-run API call from above 2) confirm viewer metrics > 0 for org_78321 3) verify no regression for other tenants.

devon (SRE): deploy complete at 02:06 UTC. patch id: hotfix/eng-5187.

alex (Support): re-running customer's query now...

alex (Support): confirmed — viewer aggregates restored for org_78321. numbers match admin view. sending closure notes.

acme-support (Acme Customer): confirmed on our side too. auditors happy. thanks everyone! :tada:
